<!--

  the prompt, an `output` line is muted. Static: the typing animation belongs to the port (TypingText contract).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CodeLine } from "./code-window.types";

export type CodeWindowProps = {
  title: string;
  prompt: string;
  lines: CodeLine[];
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { title, prompt, lines, class: className } = defineProps<CodeWindowProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Box
    :class="cn(
      'w-full overflow-hidden rounded bg-card text-left inset-ring inset-ring-border',
      className
    )"
    role="group"
    :aria-label="title"
    data-slot="code-window"
  >
    <Box class="flex items-center border-b border-border px-4 py-2">
      <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ title }}
      </Text>
    </Box>
    <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 p-4 font-mono text-sm">
      <ListItem v-for="line in lines" :key="line.id"
        :class="cn('flex gap-2', ((line.kind === 'command') ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground'))"
        :data-kind="line.kind"
        data-slot="code-line"
      >
        <Inline v-if="(line.kind === 'command')" class="select-none text-muted-foreground">
          {{ prompt }}
        </Inline>
        <Inline>
          {{ line.text }}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    </List>
  </Box>
